intro: Short stories about the people in our family tree, told by Vivien. One generation at a time, starting with the first ancestor who reached the Cape. About ten minutes each.

episodes.title: The Man from Königstein
episodes.blurb: A merchant from Saxony steps off the ship Pampas into Table Bay in 1691.

episodes.title: The Year of the Pox
episodes.blurb: Rooi Dirk, the first of the family born in Africa, and the smallpox of 1713.

episodes.title: Beyond the Mountains
episodes.blurb: Pioneer farmers move inland, and the family name changes its spelling.

episodes.title: When the Flags Changed
episodes.blurb: Dutch, then British, then Dutch, then British again, in one lifetime.

episodes.title: Wagons North
episodes.blurb: The end of slavery, the Great Trek, and a life that ended near Harrismith.

episodes.title: The War Years
episodes.blurb: The Anglo-Boer War and the years of rebuilding.

episodes.title: Machadodorp
episodes.blurb: Depression, war, and a wedding in Machadodorp in 1951.

episodes.title: The Weaver
episodes.blurb: The season finale, about the person who wove this tapestry together.
